# thread subject

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:threadSubject`](gmeow-threadSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/threadSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The base subject of a conversation thread, with reply/forward prefixes stripped, used for display and grouping. Derived from the raw RFC 5322 Subject headers of the messages in the thread.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Thread`](../classes/gmeow-Thread.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)
